description: User says 'what is this?' while the scene contains two plausible referents (a mug and a bottle) at similar positions, both with high individual grounding confidence. The deictic detector fires (deictic_reference=True) but the grounding pass returns two candidates neither of which is dominant. SpeakPolicy must not produce a confident full_response; it must produce action_type in {clarification, silence} with primary_reason_code=DEICTIC_AMBIGUOUS. Sub-case: single-candidate unambiguous frame — grounding resolves confidently to action_type=full_response (positive discriminator so the test is non-vacuous).

fixture_conventions.deictic_p: Scripted DeicticModel output probability. Values >= 0.8 indicate a deictic reference ('this', 'that one'). Values < 0.3 indicate non-deictic.
fixture_conventions.scene_change_score: Scripted scene-change score in [0.0, 1.0]. High values (> 0.5) indicate scene boundary.
fixture_conventions.grounding_result: Stub label returned by GroundingModel. 'ambiguous' indicates the harness detected >= 2 plausible candidates with similar confidence. 'mug' is the unambiguous single-candidate result.
fixture_conventions.grounding_confidence: Stub confidence value in [0.0, 1.0]. Values < 0.5 represent ambiguity or low confidence. For the ambiguous case, each individual candidate confidence is scripted; the fixture encodes the per-candidate pair as candidate_a_confidence / candidate_b_confidence fields.
fixture_conventions.candidate_a_label: Label of the first grounding candidate (main/ambiguous sub-case).
fixture_conventions.candidate_a_confidence: Confidence of the first grounding candidate. Scripted to 0.72 — plausible but not dominant.
fixture_conventions.candidate_b_label: Label of the second grounding candidate (main/ambiguous sub-case).
fixture_conventions.candidate_b_confidence: Confidence of the second grounding candidate. Scripted to 0.68 — close to candidate A, genuine ambiguity.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: String field: 'ambiguous' or 'unambiguous'. Consumers (task 13) partition frames by this field.
fixture_conventions.ambiguous_case_design: Frames 000-003: user speaks 'what is this?'. deictic_p=0.91 => deictic_reference=True. Scene has two candidates: mug (0.72) and bottle (0.68). Neither is dominant (difference < 0.1). Harness must route to DEICTIC_AMBIGUOUS => action_type in {clarification, silence}.
fixture_conventions.unambiguous_case_design: Frames 100-103: same utterance, but scene has only one candidate: mug (0.92). Harness resolves to full_response. This sub-case is the positive discriminator — the test fails if DEICTIC_AMBIGUOUS is returned for every frame regardless of scene content.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: 5-byte magic header b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte. Grounding results are scripted, not produced from real pixels.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings in signal_trace are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 canonical event_types. 'raw_video_frame' and 'deictic_classification' ARE canonical Part 5 types when emitted by adapters; here they label the fixture phase.
